test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT an eye condition/disease?
solution:
Correct answer is__** Goiter.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• A goitre is **a lump or swelling at the front of the neck caused by a swollen thyroid**.
 
• The **thyroid is a small gland in our neck** that makes hormones.
 
• Goitres are not generally serious but should be **checked by a GP.**
 
• The most general cause of goiters worldwide is a **absence**** of iodine in the diet**.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5de63d4068dd9a56c577fb2568b42405f8d50c51b03526f10248893783f6309.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Dry eye disease is **a common condition that occurs when your tears aren't able to provide adequate lubrication for your eyes**. ​ 
 
• Cataracts are **when the lens, a small transparent disc inside your eye, develops cloudy patches**.
 
• Glaucoma is **a group of eye conditions that damage the optic nerve.**
